resources.string: Done
Copy original still
HEIC encoding is unavailable: Android 9 or newer and a compatible encoder are required.
Copies the original primary still at the Motion Photo cover unchanged. Source XMP is retained; appended video is excluded.
Original copy requires a Motion Photo with a JPEG or HEIC/HEIF primary still. A video frame has no standalone original image to copy.
JPEG and HEIC encode a new image. Quality 100 does not copy unchanged source bytes.
Motion Photo output uses JPEG (.jpg), even with HEIC selected. HEIC applies again when Motion Photo is off.
Motion Photo output uses JPEG (.jpg) with an appended video clip.
Original copy keeps source quality, resolution and metadata unchanged. Encoding controls do not apply.

Mute exported motion audio
Keep source base + position
Keep source base + frame
Name or template (without extension)
Leave blank for automatic naming. Literal names get time and position suffixes. Unsafe characters are replaced and long output names are shortened.
Use at most 80 characters. This edit has not been applied.
Complete each token in braces, such as {filename}. This edit has not been applied.
Use only {filename}, {timestamp}, {position} or {frame}. This edit has not been applied.
Open media to see its actual filename and token values.
Fix the template to preview it. Export keeps the last valid name.
Export filename

{filename}: source basename without extension. {timestamp}: chosen time in epoch milliseconds. {position}: video presentation time in microseconds, padded to 12 digits. {frame}: nearest estimated zero-based frame index, padded to 8 digits.
Frame rate is unavailable, so {frame} is 00000000. Use {position} for an exact presentation time.
